bound_frozen_plan.amendment_rule: Frozen research-question, method, endpoint, matrix, seed, budget, failure and analysis choices may not change without a versioned author-authorized amendment.

bound_contract_green_implementation.frozen_scope: S6-I1 deterministic core, S6-I2 pre-evaluated parent transition, S6-I3 online state, and S6-I4 evaluator-forbidden in-memory dry-run metadata only.

verified_present_capabilities: constraint-residual conversion and frozen lexicographic comparison
midpoint repair, success-memory update and a pre-evaluated one-generation parent trace
rolling violation history, graph activation/fallback state and CVGR donor-core delegation
evaluator-forbidden validation of planned metadata and in-memory dry-run bundle schemas

blocking_gaps.component: complete optimizer state and generation loop
blocking_gaps.evidence: No optimizer entry point or optimize/run_optimizer symbol exists; trace_parent_generation consumes pre-evaluated trials and deterministic draws only.
blocking_gaps.required_before_execution: Population initialization, SHADE parameter sampling, p-best selection, mutation, crossover, midpoint repair, evaluator call, selection, archive/memory/population schedule, checkpointing and exact fixed-FFE termination must be integrated without changing the frozen CVGR contract.

blocking_gaps.evidence: No problem/evaluator production module or adapter file exists.
blocking_gaps.required_before_execution: One-call objective-plus-ordered-residual interface, equality tolerances, decision-vector hashing/cache provenance, complete violation output, finite-value rejection and exactly-one-FFE ledger semantics.

blocking_gaps.evidence: The mathematical synthetic suite and CEC2006 inventory exist only as specifications/metadata.
blocking_gaps.required_before_execution: Twelve deterministic synthetic instances require gold-value and rotation-oracle tests. CEC2006-eligible-16 and fallback-8 require source/version/hash/license identity, dimension/bounds/constraint-count oracles and independent conformance points before C1/F.

blocking_gaps.evidence: No executable adapters exist for PARENT, CVGR, DEG_REWIRE, DIV_MATCH, LABEL_PERM, SCALAR_CV or NO_STABILITY.
blocking_gaps.required_before_execution: All variants must share evaluator, initialization, base RNG, SHADE code, comparator, repair, stopping and FFE ledger; only the registered intervention may differ, with graph_rng isolated.

blocking_gaps.evidence: No executable config schema or one-config-per-matrix-row/algorithm/problem/seed expansion exists; pyproject declares no CLI.
blocking_gaps.required_before_execution: Versioned config schema, frozen defaults, registered matrix row IDs, 30 common seeds, stable run IDs, deterministic scheduling and rejection of hidden/unregistered overrides.

blocking_gaps.evidence: G1-G5 exist only in the frozen failure tree; no runtime branch-action monitor exists.
blocking_gaps.required_before_execution: FFE equality, fallback equivalence, wall-clock overhead, activation rate and infrastructure-failure thresholds must preserve packages and stop/downgrade exactly as preregistered.

blocking_gaps.component: immutable run bundle, failure recovery and resume
blocking_gaps.evidence: Current S6-I4 builds planned objects in memory and deliberately creates zero run packages.
blocking_gaps.required_before_execution: Atomic package closure, manifest/config/environment/code/input hashes, stdout/stderr, checkpoints, raw metrics, final records, donor/graph diagnostics, FFE ledger, failure artifacts, one-retry recovery and non-overwrite resume semantics.

blocking_gaps.evidence: Only deterministic unit contracts exist; no evaluator-bearing smoke, fixed-seed duplicate run or complete bundle verification has occurred.
blocking_gaps.required_before_execution: After separately authorized implementation, run gold/property/metamorphic tests, exact fallback traces, same-environment same-seed duplicate smoke packages and run-artifact checks before any M budget is released.

required_tdd_sequence: S6-E0-R1: write versioned specifications, deterministic fixtures and additive tests for G1-G8; tests must collect and fail only because the new production APIs are absent, with no evaluator call.
S6-E0-F1: hash-freeze the red baseline and independently restore its complete dependency closure.
S6-E0-I1: obtain a separate authorization for production implementation and deterministic unit-evaluator tests; preserve formal FFE at zero and keep benchmark execution prohibited.
S6-E0-F2: freeze and independently restore the complete executable optimizer, adapters, configs, CLI, guardrails and run-bundle system after all frozen tests are green.
S6-E0-X0: obtain a separate, budget-specific authorization for a bounded smoke/pilot only; formal M/C1/F remain prohibited until its artifacts pass integrity and exact-FFE gates.
M/C1/F: execute only under their own hash-bound phase authorizations and preregistered kill branches; C2 remains optional and separate.
hard_stops_for_next_phase: Any frozen plan, implementation snapshot, test, fixture or source byte is edited instead of adding a versioned artifact.
Any additive test invokes an objective, constraint, benchmark or optimizer during the red-specification phase.
Any new API silently changes a frozen endpoint, comparator, seed, budget, stopping, fallback or FFE rule.
Any CEC2006 adapter is treated as confirmed before source/version/hash/license and conformance evidence close.
Any formal run directory, run package, optimizer result, performance metric or formal FFE is created.
Any performance, superiority, convergence, robustness, novelty, physical-validation or paper-readiness claim is inferred from static or red-phase evidence.
claim_boundary: This audit establishes implementation/execution incompleteness and a TDD-safe next gate. It is not experimental evidence and does not authorize or predict algorithm performance.
